Generates a RVD sequences set from a tale_parts object

Source: R/conversion.R
tale_parts_to_rvd.Rd

Returns a BStringSet of RVD sequences, one per array, ordered by position_in_array and joined with sep.

Usage

tale_parts_to_rvd(tale_parts, sep = "-", rvd_only = FALSE)

Arguments

tale_parts

A tales object or data frame with array_id, position_in_array and rvd columns.

sep

Separator joining consecutive RVDs within an array's string.

rvd_only

Return only RVDs and omit N- and C-terminal domains.

Value

A BStringSet, one element per array, named by array_id.

See also

Other tales projections: repeat_to_rvd_map(), repeat_to_rvd_map_distalr(), tales_coded_strings(), tales_domain_codes(), tales_get_dna_seq(), tales_get_protein_seq(), tales_rvd_strings(), tales_to_universalmotif()

Examples

parts <- data.frame(
  array_id = c("A1", "A1", "A1", "A2", "A2"),
  position_in_array = c(1, 2, 3, 1, 2),
  rvd = c("NTERM", "HD", "CTERM", "NTERM", "NI")
)
tale_parts_to_rvd(parts)
#> BStringSet object of length 2:
#>     width seq                                               names               
#> [1]    14 NTERM-HD-CTERM                                    A1
#> [2]     8 NTERM-NI                                          A2
